CT is the most accurate imaging technique for detecting liver metastases.
the extent of colorectol liver metastases can only be reliably assessed by CT scanning, but that the relative blood flow in tumours and normal liver can only be measured by dynamic liver scanning.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
dynamic liver scintigraphic imaging is the most sensitive and accurate method of staging colorectal liver metastasis, but that it has not yet been shown to be clinically useful.
the extent of tumours is underestimated by CT, and overestimated by isotope and ultrasound.
the best method for imaging the liver is a combination of ultrasound, CT and scintigraphy.
